title: fix(metadata-protocol): a form view naming a field its object lacks reads with the lint's form-field-unknown warning
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9MP94x2mHLb3VMeZqcfx4Es)_
Fixes #29196

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：表单视图的分区里写了对象上不存在的字段时，`/meta` 读取（已发布、草稿、草稿预览）的 `_diagnostics.warnings` 现在会带上 lint 规则 `form-field-unknown` 的原文警告，定位到具体字段引用。
- 为什么改：这种表单以前保存、发布、读取都显示 `valid: true`，作者完全不知道字段被静默跳过；规则早就有，只是只在 CLI 里跑。
- 风险与回滚：只加警告，不改 `valid`、不拒绝保存或发布；列表读取不受影响。回滚即还原本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.ts`（`withFormLayoutWarnings`，ViewItem 的 `config` 适配与对象查找），`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`（读取出口的三处接线），`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.form-layout-diagnostics.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.form-layout-diagnostics.test.ts`，预期 4 个用例全绿；在 main 上同一命令有 2 个红。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`validateFormLayout` (`@objectstack/lint`) reports a form section field the bound object does not have as `form-field-unknown` ("is silently skipped and never renders on the form"). It ran only in the CLI, so the meta door served such a view with `_diagnostics: { valid: true }`.

- **`withFormLayoutWarnings`** (new, `metadata-diagnostics.ts`): runs `validateFormLayout` on the served view body and appends each `form-field-unknown` finding to `_diagnostics.warnings` as the spec's `{ path, message }`, with the rule's own message and an item-relative path. `valid` and `errors` are left as they were.
  - A stored form `ViewItem` (`viewKind: 'form'`) keeps its form under `config`, a rung the lint's view walk does not descend. It is handed to the rule as the container shape the walk reads (`{ name, object, form: config }`), and the finding's `form.` path is mapped back to `config.` (QA's reproduction reads `config.sections.0.fields.1`). Containers and flattened form overlays are the walk's own input already.
  - The object universe is the door's own lookup: `registry.getObject(name)` (the served object, extensions folded on) for each object name the body spells. A name it cannot resolve is left out, so that form is not judged and gets no warning.
  - `@objectstack/lint` is imported lazily from its root on the first view read, the way `build-probes.ts` loads `validateObjectFieldRefs`. The kernel boot path still reaches the package only through `/runtime`.
- **`readMetaItem`** (`protocol.ts`): the pass runs at every served exit of the single-item read: the active read (after the ADR-0047 reference merge, which rebuilds `_diagnostics` from its errors), the strict draft read, and the draft-preview arm (both through `serveDraft`, before the #26707 publish verdict is folded in). The execution face serves no `_diagnostics` and is untouched. `getMetaItems` (the list read) is untouched.

Which attach site the served read uses: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`'s `readMetaItem` (`decorateMetadataItem` plus the view reference merge). The card's `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts` is not on that path.

## Tests

- New `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.form-layout-diagnostics.test.ts`, through the protocol's own save, publish and read (the methods `PUT /meta/view/NAME?mode=draft`, `POST .../publish` and `GET` call), with the stub engine shape of `protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts`:
  1. QA's ViewItem body: the draft saves, its read carries the warning, the publish is not refused, and the active read carries the same warning. The message is compared against `validateFormLayout` run in the same test.
  2. A view container's `formViews.edit` is judged and located under its own key.
  3. Control: a form naming only fields the served object has (one of them only on the served object, not the authored one) reads exactly `{ valid: true }`, draft and active.
  4. A form whose object does not resolve reads exactly `{ valid: true }`.
- Forced edit: `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` gains the new file's three engine-double rows (`check:engine-double-contract`'s own `--write`).

## Acceptance notes

- The warning carries no rule id on the read wire: `MetadataValidationResultSchema.warnings` entries are `{ path, message }` in the spec, the shape the read's other derived warnings already use. Carrying `code` is a spec widening, left as an open question in the card report.
- The save and publish responses' `advisories` do not carry this finding: `validateFormLayout` is CLI-only on the runtime publish surface in the lint registry. Crossing it is a registry decision, left as an open question.
- `form-section-group-unknown`, the rule's sibling finding, is not surfaced at the door (this card names `form-field-unknown` only).
- The layered read (`?layers=true`) `_diagnostics` stays schema-only, as it already is for the ADR-0047 reference errors.
- Studio: `ResourceEditPage` already renders `_diagnostics.warnings` with their paths. The form designer canvas has no reader of them; named as a `domain:ui` follow-up in the card report.
- Cost: about 25 µs per single view read (2000 reads of a 6-section, 36-field form against a 40-field object, measured in-process). The list read pays nothing.

## Verification

Head `1560285c` (main merged at `eed73a39`). Every run below goes through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`; each line quotes the run's own verdict.

<details><summary>Red first on main (104cd1a5, test only)</summary>

`vitest run src/protocol.form-layout-diagnostics.test.ts`: `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`. Failing: the ViewItem case at the draft read (`expected { valid: true } to deeply equal { valid: true, warnings: [ { …(2) } ] }`) and the container case (`expected undefined to deeply equal [ { …(2) } ]`). The two controls passed.
</details>

<details><summary>Green on the fix</summary>

- The pin: `Tests 4 passed (4)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` on `1560285c`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `Test Files 301 passed | 4 skipped (305)`, `Tests 22111 passed | 26 skipped (22137)`.
- eslint (`eslint.js packages/metadata-protocol --no-inline-config`): exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, each restored to the HEAD blob with an empty git diff HEAD)</summary>

Run on `42185878`, the fix before the two main merges; neither merge touched `readMetaItem` or `metadata-diagnostics.ts`.

- A, the active-exit call deleted from `readMetaItem`: `Tests 1 failed | 3 passed`, the ViewItem case red at the active read.
- B, an unresolvable object name given an empty field set instead of being left out: `Tests 1 failed | 3 passed`, the unresolvable-object case red.
- C, the lookup switched from `registry.getObject` to the authored `listItems('object')`: `Tests 1 failed | 3 passed`, the served-object control red (`region__c` reported).
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `1560285c`: 70 commands, all exit 0 (after a full `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**'`). `--ran` reconciliation: `70 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)`.
</details>

No `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm, so the full dogfood battery is not owed.
